pdMeasureRadioPower.toolTip: Requests the nominal radio setting without transmitting. Wait for radio readback before arming; actual output is measured separately.

pdMeasureWindow.accessibleDescription: Window choice changes leakage and frequency resolution; no window guarantees a fixed measurable IMD depth.

pdMeasureOrder.accessibleDescription: Highest odd distortion product to analyze: three, five or seven.
